page.layout: One block of text at top, with marginal notes in the left margin (references a to d). Below the text, centred: "INSTITUTIONUM FINIS." in italic capitals, then a woodcut ornament. At the lower right, a small line "EPI" in display type.

main_text.p: v.ff. & c. ad l.Iul.de ambitu.Iulia de ambitu {a}, lex Iulia repetundarum {b}, & lex Iulia de annona {c}, & lex Iulia de residuis {d}, quae de certis capitulis loquuntur: & animas quidem amis-sionem non irrogant: aliis autem poenis eos subii-ciunt qui praecepta earum neglexerint. Sed de publi-cis iudiciis haec expofuimus, ut vobis pofsibile fit summo digito, & quasi per indicem ea tetigisse, alioqui diligentior eorum scientia vobis ex latioribus Digestorum seu Pandectarum libris Deo propitio aducentura est.

page.notes: Left margin notes, as printed: "a v.ff. & c. ad l.Iul.de ambitu."; "b v.ff. & c. ad l.Iul.repet."; "c v.ff.de an-nona."; "d v.l.2.ff.ad l.Iul.pecul." The text marks a to d are placed where the printed superscript letters stand; the note texts for b, c and d are attached to the first paragraph as their letters indicate. The woodcut ornament (cornucopia with cherub and ribbons) is not text. The line "EPI" at the lower right is partly unclear; it is recorded as a catchword with [?]. Line-end hyphens in "amis-sionem", "subii-ciunt" and "publi-cis" are kept as printed. The text in the lower half of the page is faint show-through and is not transcribed.
